# Mobile Shop — mobile shop software for Pakistan

> Mobile Shop (موبائل شاپ) by OOP Solutions is software for mobile phone shops in Pakistan. It covers new and used phones with CNIC verification and the seller's signed consent, IMEI-wise stock, udhaar khata, repairs with outside repair labs, accessories, installments and a complete shop audit. It runs as an Android app, online on any browser, and offline, in Urdu, Roman Urdu and English.

- Website: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/welcome
- Android app: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/app.apk
- Maker: OOP Solutions — https://oopsolutions.com — Abdur Rehman Afzal, +92 316 4001668 (WhatsApp)
- Related: iFix Apple Phone — https://ifixapplephone.com

## What makes it different
- Android app, online on any device, and offline. An offline sale is sent once the internet is back; a one-PC Windows install runs without internet.
- Used-phone verification: the seller's CNIC (camera scan), PTA status, IMEI, and the iCloud / Google lock on tablets and watches. A phone with a pending check cannot be sold.
- Seller's consent: the seller signs the purchase declaration on the screen. The signature is saved with the CNIC and IMEI and printed on the declaration.
- Three languages: Urdu (Nastaliq, right to left), Roman Urdu and English, with a "?" and a shop example on every field.

## Modules
- Sale: cash, online, cheque, from abroad, udhaar or installments; WhatsApp or printed bill.
- Add stock: from a dealer, or a used phone from a customer; barcode on every unit.
- Stock and IMEI: each phone's full history from purchase to sale.
- Udhaar khata: one page per person, ageing, WhatsApp reminders.
- Len-den: money lent or borrowed with no bill, return dates and reminders.
- Money in / out: galla, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash, cheque; transfers; day close.
- Returns and exchange.
- Repairs: take in, send to an outside repair lab, track every lab, repair sticker, give back with the bill.
- Accessories: bought by the dozen or box, sold by the piece; FIFO or average cost; low-stock alerts.
- Installments with guarantor and reminders.
- Expenses by category; owner drawings kept apart.
- Shop audit: profit, cash, udhaar, stock, sales, purchases, staff, repairs, len-den — any period, print and Excel.
- Staff roles: owner, manager, salesman, technician. A salesman never sees buying prices or profit.
- Barcodes and stickers with any USB / Bluetooth scanner.

## Prices (PKR)
- Basic Rs. 1,500 / month, Pro Rs. 3,000 / month, Chain Rs. 6,000 / month.
- Yearly: 12 months for the price of 10 (2 months free).
- 14 days free trial.

## Common questions
- Is there an Urdu mobile shop software in Pakistan? Yes — Mobile Shop runs fully in Urdu, Roman Urdu or English.
- Does it work without internet? Yes — offline sales are kept and sent later; a one-PC Windows install needs no internet.
- Can staff use it without seeing profit? Yes — the salesman role sells, adds stock, takes returns and payments, but never sees cost or profit.
